description: This Java class 'ProductPriceUtils' provides utility methods for handling product pricing, including price retrieval, final price calculation, formatting amounts with currency, and discount determination within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductPriceUtils
classes.description: Utility class for managing product pricing, including price retrieval, final price calculation, formatting, and discount logic.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the default (non-discounted) price of a product for a given store and locale.

methods.name: getFinalProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final product price considering product attributes with positive attribute prices.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final price of a product based on all configured prices and discounts, excluding attributes.

methods.name: getAdminFormatedAmount
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount for admin input fields, using a fixed locale and decimal count.

methods.name: getStoreFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount with currency in either national or international format based on store settings.

methods.name: getFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount with a specified locale and currency.

methods.name: getAdminFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount with store currency for admin purposes.

methods.name: getFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount with currency using a specified currency object.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Parses a string amount into BigDecimal, handling different formats and locale-specific decimal/thousand separators.

methods.name: getOrderProductTotalPrice
methods.description: Calculates total price for an order product based on quantity and unit price.

methods.name: hasDiscount
methods.description: Determines if a ProductPrice has an active discount based on current date and discount period.

methods.name: calculateFinalPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final price of a product considering all availabilities and prices.

methods.name: finalPrice
methods.description: Creates a FinalPrice object for a given ProductPrice, considering discounts and special prices.

methods.name: discountPrice
methods.description: Calculates and sets discount percentage and discounted price for a FinalPrice object.
